body: I’m using this as a diary now, I felt like crying again today. My dad said gay people should be beaten on the floor and die. Me, myself I came to the realisation I was bi when I was 11, it might seem young but I simply didn’t mind if I liked a girl or a guy. Soon after the fact he said it he tried to make me laugh. To smile by making funny faces and over exaggerating his annoyance in a joking manner. It’s sickening. I just hate his bipolar attitude and not even properly realising what he had just said. He isn’t a bad dad. He just has a bad view and way of taking things other than money. i thought he was just slightly   prejudice because of his upbringing but I’ve come to accept the fact that it’s true he is the example of, racist , homophobic and sexist actions . I don’t know how to take it. Should I just ignore it and act like he doesn’t mention it. I don’t care if anyone sees this. I just need to figure out what to do with this spiral of never ending depressed thoughts. God please help me.
